Fruit Ketchup
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, February 12, 2010 - 2:35am

Ingredients




15 Tomatoes, large, skins removed
3 Apples (Peeled and cored
3 Pears (Peeled and cored
3 Peaches (skinned
3 cups White sugar
cup White vinegar
3 Onions (Chopped)
tablespoon Pickling salt
1 lrg Green pepper (chopped)
head Celery (chopped)
1 teaspoon Pickling spice (do not need to put in cheese clo
20 Tomatoes
4 lrgs Apples
4 Pears
5 Peaches
cup Sugar
Same amount of vinegar as above
4 lrgs Onions
2 tablespoons Pickling salt
3 lrgs Peppers, I used 2 green and 1 red for variety
head of Celery
1 tablespoon Pickling spice

Preparation

1 Although the second part of this recipe is my own variation, this recipe is truly an authentic French Canadian pickle made in most parts of Quebec, Canada. Therefore, most French Canadian cooks will have a slightly different version of this recipe. 2 Simmer approximately 2 hours or until thick. 3 Yield: Approximately 6-8 pint. 4 To Make a thicker ketchup, I used the above: 5 If you prefer a firmer fruit, you would add celery, peppers, onions, sugar, vinegar and spices and cook slightly longer before adding fruit-especially if fruit is very ripe. Simmer at least 2 hours until thick: 6 Yield: 7 Quarts 7 LAST SEASON I MADE ALMOST 20 QUARTS OF THIS-WE JUST LOVE IT.
